B is the concrete Lemma 3.60 in the setting of Theorem 3.58, with the O of Lemma 3.59. A ⇒ B was proved with the family L(b) = P_Y ∘ Df(b)|_X built as for V3_52, now on every level (Df(b) : E_m → F_m is the level operator at a continuous lift of b to E_{m+1}). O and its injectivity come from the project's lemma_3_7_2 (allowed, it is not this item's theorem). For Õ with compact closure in O, the hypothesis lemma_3_7_3 is applied on K = cl(Õ) as a compact subset of B, with continuity from Proposition 1.16(2), level-m injectivity from level 0 (ScOperator.injective_lvl) and FamilyCompactness from CompactnessProp. B's P_Y(Df(b)h) = y follows from the uniqueness of F_m = Y_m ⊕ A_m. B ⇒ A fails genuinely: A is about arbitrary continuous families with the compactness property, which need not come from an sc-smooth f in the setting of Theorem 3.58.
